ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, observe the compass and straightedge constructions in the diagram. If $\angle FMO = 50^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle FOE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the drawing, we know that PQ perpendicularly bisects FM, \\
$\therefore$ point E is the midpoint of the arc $\overset{\frown}{FM}$, \\
$\therefore$ $\overset{\frown}{FE} = \overset{\frown}{EM}$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle MOE = \angle BOE = \frac{1}{2}\angle AOB$, \\
Also, $\because \angle FMO = 50^\circ$, $\angle OFM = 90^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle AOB = 40^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle FOE = \boxed{20^\circ}$,

method.method_draft: Use an analytic-coordinate/trigonometric route. From the image, place O at (0,0) and M at (2,0), so the semicircle has center Q = (1,0) and radius 1; F and E are on this circle, and PQ is the perpendicular bisector of segment FM. From the text, ∠FMO = 50°. Because F lies on the semicircle with diameter OM, triangle OFM is right at F, so the direction of OF from O makes angle 40° above OM. Thus F lies on the ray from O at 40° and on the circle. Now compute the perpendicular bisector of FM: in a circle, the perpendicular bisector of chord FM passes through Q, and its intersection E with the minor arc FM has central direction halfway between the central directions of F and M. Equivalently, E is the arc midpoint between F and M. Since the arc FM is bisected at E, the ray OE lies halfway between rays OF and OM as seen by the inscribed angle at O. Therefore the angle between OF and OE is half of ∠FOM = 40°, giving ∠FOE = 20°.

图像描述：图中有一条水平直线 O-M-A，O 和 M 是半圆的两个端点，半圆在直线上方，中心标为 Q。点 F 和点 E 都在半圆弧上，线段 OF 沿斜线延长到 B，线段 OE 画出；另有一条经过 Q、E 并延长到 P 的斜线，作为对弦 FM 的垂直平分构造线。

推理：按解析方法设 O=(0,0)，M=(2,0)，则半圆圆心 Q=(1,0)，半径为 1。因为 F 在以 OM 为直径的半圆上，所以 ∠OFM=90°。已知 ∠FMO=50°，因此三角形 OFM 中 ∠FOM=180°-90°-50°=40°，即射线 OF 与 OM 的夹角为 40°。设 F 在射线方向 40° 上并在圆 (x-1)^2+y^2=1 上，可得 F=(1+cos80°, sin80°)，所以从圆心 Q 看，F 的中心方向为 80°，而 M 的中心方向为 0°。图中的 PQ 是弦 FM 的垂直平分线，因此它经过圆心 Q，并与弧 FM 交于弧中点 E，所以 E 的中心方向为 40°，即 E=(1+cos40°, sin40°)。于是从 O 看，OE 的方向角满足 tan∠MOE=sin40°/(1+cos40°)=tan20°，所以 ∠MOE=20°。而 OF 的方向角是 40°，故 ∠FOE=40°-20°=20°。
